results.title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
results.content:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage often returns documents that merely share keywords with the query.
…
We propose a causal reranking stage that keeps documents containing the needed information.

results.title: Four retrieval techniques to improve RAG you need to know
results.content: It's not surprising, then, that we've seen a range of different approaches emerge that attempt to address RAG's limitations over the last year or so.

results.title: Hybrid search for retrieval: BM25 plus embeddings — résumé
results.author: Ana Pérez
results.content: Combining lexical and dense retrieval recovers exact-match terms that embeddings miss.
